about: A node whose id is the id of a node it can see (chapter 1 § 1.9.2). Invalid: the for sections holds a node plan, and the top level has one. Valid: the inner node is outline.
sentences: Node 'plan' in sections reuses the id of node 'plan' at the top level, which sections can read: rename one. Ids may repeat only where neither can see the other (for example in two sibling loops).
